deployment_variables.description: Non-sensitive GitHub production variables required by deploy.yml.

github_actions_role_arn.description: Set as the AWS_ROLE_ARN secret of the bflow-mcp production environment.

aws_region.description: AWS region. Must match the monolith's region: the cluster and subnets are shared.

cognito_extra_callback_urls.description: Pre-DCR direct callbacks. update-user-pool-client replaces the whole list, so every platform still using the real client id must stay listed.

cognito_hosted_ui_domain.description: Hosted UI domain, passed through to the deployment variables output only.

cognito_scopes.description: Custom scopes of the resource server (scope name => description).

cognito_user_pool_id.description: Existing Cognito user pool shared with the web app.

dns_sync_enabled.description: Creates the DNS-sync Lambda for mcp.bflow-studio.com after its zip exists and the shared EventBridge rule is deployed.

dns_sync_event_target_id.description: Target id on the shared rule. The bash script used Id=2 (the monolith's Lambda is the other target).

dns_sync_function_name.description: Verify against `aws lambda list-functions`: the bash script derived it as <PROJECT_NAME>-mcp-dns-sync.

dns_sync_log_retention_days.description: Retention of the Lambda's log group. Same default as the monolith's (7 days).

dns_sync_secret_name.description: Secret container for the Cloudflare credentials. Terraform never holds its value.

dns_sync_zip_path.description: Built Lambda zip. The Go source lives ONLY in BFlow-Financial-Engine/infra/dns-sync (same binary, configured per service by env vars); build it there and point this at the resulting lambda_function.zip.

ecr_lifecycle_max_images.description: Opt-in after migration: retain only this many images. Null preserves the current repository policy state.

ecs_task_role_name.description: Intentionally has zero permissions attached (ADR-0010 section 1).

github_owner_id.description: Immutable GitHub owner id. The existing trust policy uses the id-based subject claim; set both ids to null to fall back to the name-based claim.

log_retention_days.description: Matches the retention the bash bootstrap applied.

manage_cognito.description: Opt-in. Manages the resource server, the app client and its Managed Login branding in an existing user pool.

mcp_container_port.description: Container port. Informational: the ingress rule lives in the monolith's security group.

mcp_public_base_url.description: Public base URL of bflow-mcp (BFLOW_MCP_PUBLIC_BASE_URL). Its /oauth/callback is the callback Cognito sees for every DCR client.

otel_traces_enabled.description: Grants the task role xray:PutTraceSegments so the ADOT Java agent can export traces straight to X-Ray (same mechanism as the monolith). The agent itself is switched on from deploy.yml, not here.

shared_ecs_cluster_name.description: Cluster shared with the monolith (no second cluster for bflow-mcp).

shared_ecs_security_group_name.description: Security group shared with the monolith. Its ingress rules (including the Cloudflare ranges on the MCP port) are owned by the monolith's ecs_ingress_rules.

shared_event_rule_name.description: EventBridge rule owned by the monolith (only exists when its dns_sync_enabled is true). bflow-mcp's Lambda is attached as an additional target.

shared_public_subnet_names.description: Name tags of the monolith's public subnets, in the order exposed as ECS_PUBLIC_SUBNET_1/2.
